operations.label: View Connection Status
operations.description: Check ODS connection health, last sync time, resource count, and readiness blockers.

operations.label: Browse Ed-Fi Data
operations.description: Read schools, students, enrollments, and any discovered resource. Governed read-only with row limits and redaction.

operations.label: Run Change Sync
operations.description: Pull changes from the ODS since the last cursor position. Advances the change version cursor on success.

operations.label: Configure Connection
operations.description: Set or update ODS URL, credentials, LEA ID, and SSL settings. Requires account_admin.

operations.label: Install / Re-profile
operations.description: First-time setup: authenticate, discover ODS metadata, save capability profile. Run again after credential rotation.
